name: Liferun
verdict: The biggest movement this period is a 35% drop in leads over the last 7 days alongside a 30.17% rise in CPL, likely driven by a 34.32% pullback in Google Ads spend and a near-total collapse in GBP-driven actions (down 95%). Meta remains the sole lead-generating channel at 133 leads on $1,691.77 spend, while Google Ads delivered 0 conversions on $501.02, suggesting budget reallocation or campaign pausing is hurting overall volume efficiency.

performance.verdict: Google zero conversions confirms budget waste; Meta CPL rising — no safe scale yet.

findings.text: CPL rose 30.17% in 7d; Meta delivered 133 leads at $16.49 CPL (28d) but 3-day lead avg (Sep 14-16: 4,8,4=5.3/day) is below prior 3-day (Sep 11-13: 6,4,0=3.3/day) — short recovery, no confirmed turnaround.
Google Ads spent $501.02 over 28 days and recorded 0 conversions; 7d spend dropped 34.32% yet results were already zero — spend is pure waste regardless of budget level.
5 overdue milestones (GHL build gaps, end-to-end stack re-test, paid landing pages, UGC batch) unresolved as of 2026-08-31 — scaling is blocked per SOW and attribution is untrusted.

GHL shows 154 opportunities created vs 133 ad leads (28d) but 0 appointments and 0 won — intake is receiving leads but pipeline is converting nothing, pointing to a CRM/follow-up process gap, not an ads problem.
GBP actions collapsed 95% in 7d (54 total over 28d, last 7 days near zero); search clicks hit 0 in 7d — organic discovery has effectively stopped.

suggestions.text: Pause Google Ads entirely: $501.02 spent over 28 days with 0 conversions is confirmed waste.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has spent $501.02 across 28 days and recorded zero conversions on 109 clicks, with a 7d spend of ~$97 also returning nothing. Pause all Google campaigns immediately to stop confirmed spend leakage. Success check: zero Google spend on next daily report by 2026-09-18. Revisit only after paid landing pages are live (overdue SOW milestone) and pixel/conversion tracking is verified end-to-end.

suggestions.text: Escalate 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer; no paid scale is defensible until end-to-end stack is verified.
suggestions.monday_update: Five milestones are overdue (oldest: Stripe QA July 20; most recent: GHL build, stack re-test, paid landing pages, UGC batch — all August 31). GHL shows 0 appointments and 0 won opportunities from 154 created opps, meaning the pipeline cannot be trusted for scale decisions. Nacer to confirm completion status on all 5 items no later than 2026-09-19. Success check: each milestone marked done with a verification Loom or written confirmation in Monday.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta CPL: 3-day avg is 5.3 leads/day at rising CPL — hold budget, re-check Sep 20.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta CPL rose 30.17% in the last 7 days and the 3-day lead average (Sep 14-16) sits at 5.3 leads/day with no confirmed recovery. Hold the current Meta budget (approx $85/day) and do not scale until CPL stabilises back toward the 28-day baseline of $16.49. Re-check on 2026-09-20 with the next 3-day window. If CPL holds flat or falls by then, a modest scale of up to 15% daily budget is defensible.
